The test failure concerns event state update issues in ODE integration when different event handlers are involved, especially those triggering RESET_STATE.

The test integrates a simple harmonic oscillator with two event handlers (SchedulingChecker instances) representing different event timing series. The test calls DormandPrince853Integrator.integrate with the differential equations and event handlers added.

The bug report explains a scenario where one event handler requests a RESET_STATE when its eventOccurred method is called. This causes other event handlers, which did not trigger events simultaneously, to remain unapdated due to an early return in the event handling logic. As a result, subsequent integration steps process with inconsistent states.

The DormandPrince853Integrator constructor is straightforward and only delegates to the base class with provided tolerance and step parameters.

Due to multiple conflicting overloads and similar signatures, I could not directly retrieve DormandPrince853Integrator.integrate code snippet. Instead, a reasonable next step is to explore methods related to event handling and event state management in DormandPrince853Integrator or its parent class. Since the problem lies in event state update and resetting, methods governing event processing or event handler notification during integration steps are likely sources of error.

I will now attempt to get code snippets for event state updates during eventOccurred calls or the overall event handling loop during integration in DormandPrince853Integrator or the parent adaptive stepsize integrator. This will help understand why an early return might prevent updating unrelated event handlers after a RESET_STATE request from one handler.

Hence, next, I want to check integrate method in the parent AdaptiveStepsizeIntegrator class where event management is often implemented. I will retrieve its code snippet.
